title: April dkNET Webinar "Using Knowledge Graphs within Biomedical Knowledge Portals: The Biomedical Translator and the Common Fund Knowledge Center"
bodyHtml: On 4/11/25 at 2pm Eastern Time, Jason Flannick presented a dkNET Webinar entitled, "Using Knowledge Graphs within Biomedical Knowledge Portals: The Biomedical Translator and the Common Fund Knowledge Center." He introduced two resources that aim to integrate biomedical knowledge: the NCATS Biomedical Translator (https://ui.transltr.io) and the Common Fund Data Ecosystem Knowledge Center (CFDE KC; cfdeknowledge.org). This webinar described the challenges and opportunities associated with knowledge graphs in areas including standards, semantic precision, and comparison to alternative approaches like large language models (LLMs). This discussion explored insights into the role that KGs should play in biomedical resource development and how they can be paired with LLMs and statistical data integration to maximize translational impact.
